procedural.content: Step 10 breakthrough: pandas/pyarrow ARE installed at system level (/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages). The --break-system-packages flag revealed "Requirement already satisfied". Previous ModuleNotFoundError was due to code_run using different Python environment (3.12) than where packages are installed (3.11). The error message "externally-managed-environment" mentioned uv, but uv is not in PATH. Solution: Must explicitly use Python 3.11 interpreter or find a way to make packages available to the 3.12 runtime.

Python environment isolation issue: code_run tool uses Python 3.12 at /opt/m4-runtime/python/cpython-3.12.12-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.12, but pandas/pyarrow are installed in Python 3.11 at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages. Solution: Write script to file and execute directly with python3.11 interpreter instead of using code_run Python mode.

Step 14 fix successful: ArrowTypeError for status column was caused by mixed types (string "active"/"inactive" from source_a vs boolean True from source_b/source_c vs missing values). Solution: Added conversion lambda in normalize_dataframe() that converts all status values to strings while preserving None for missing values: `df_norm['status'] = df_norm['status'].apply(lambda x: str(x) if pd.notna(x) and x is not None else None)`. This allows parquet serialization to proceed without type conflicts.
